name: Mohamed “Adly”
quote: I might be the reason someone falls in love with the ocean.
about:
"I'm a PADI scuba instructor, a freediver and a kitesurf instructor, with more than 1,500 dives from the Red Sea to the Caribbean. Today I live in Baja California Sur, between the wind of La Ventana and the Sea of Cortez.

On day one I watch before anyone speaks: who brings their own gear, who shows up early, who talks for the group. By the first briefing, I know where each person is starting from. My job is to put you in the right place at the right moment, so the rays come to us."
history:
"In Tanzania, with a group of beginner divers, the current came up stronger than forecast. I saw the hesitation at the briefing and changed site on the spot: calmer water, the same marine life. One diver surfaced saying it was the best dive of her life. The whole boat was buzzing.

Before Baja, I led dive groups of four to eight, and outdoor programs for groups of students."
why:
"The first time I went in, the ocean showed me what it could do: the life, the silence, the feeling of being part of something much bigger. I wanted other people to feel it, not as something to check off a list, but as something that changes how they see the world.

What I love most is watching someone who stood on the boat thinking they couldn't do it find out they're braver than they thought."
imageAlt: Adly, expedition leader with Eagle Ray Expeditions
